title: The Pinata Free-For-All! IV
description: The Pinata Free-For-All! IV — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Excited Lad

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy the Pinata three times and Slay 3 Hero Gladiators in the Pinata Free-For-All off of Level 2 of Ratsputins Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 2 King's Coins

Return to: Excited Lad

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Destroy the Pinata three times and Slay 3 Hero Gladiators in the Pinata Free-For-All off of Level 2 of Ratsputins Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

The last stage of the Pinata Free-For-All is by far the toughest, but you are ready, I can see it in your xp bar. What you do here will define you for the rest of this play session! I don't use the word Legend often, but can you look at this map and tell me what this symbol is? I can't read.

Head out to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 2 of Ratsputin's Gulag when you are ready to get started. There you will have to destroy the Pinata three separate times as well as slay three Hero Gladiators. When you are done return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

You are the best at the Pinata Free-For-All since Whomper Jones, the famous blind Dungeon Runner! He was a true Pinata Hero! Too bad about that whole mishap in the Embercore Path.... They really need to put up railings in that dungeon! Let me know when you are ready to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Destroy Pinatas
  • Slay Hero Gladiators

Level range: 90–100
